attendancePolicy.description: Students must maintain at least 75% attendance in each subject to be eligible for end-semester examinations.
attendancePolicy.shortageRule: Students below 75% may be required to submit medical or official approval documents.

syllabus.subject: Database Management Systems
units: Introduction to DBMS, data models, schemas and instances
ER model, relational model and relational algebra
SQL, joins, nested queries and views

syllabus.subject: Operating Systems
units: Introduction to operating systems and system calls
Process management, CPU scheduling and threads
Memory management, paging and virtual memory
File systems, disk scheduling and protection

syllabus.subject: Computer Networks
units: Network models, OSI and TCP/IP architecture
Data link layer, error detection and MAC protocols
Network layer, IP addressing and routing algorithms
Transport layer, TCP, UDP and congestion control
Application layer protocols, DNS, HTTP and email
